title: Age Statistics
description:
**Goal:** Turn an age in years into days, hours, minutes, seconds, heartbeats.
```
Age in years: 20
That's about:
  7300 days
  175200 hours
  10512000 minutes
  630720000 seconds
  ~736,000,000 heartbeats (at 70 bpm)
```
requirements: Notice when numbers get big — what happens at age 70 with `int` seconds? (Overflow — preview of [[2.02 Integers]]. Try `long long`.)
